fixed_paragraph: When I encounter a new idea, I prefer to stick with what I already know. When someone suggests trying a new restaurant, I usually opt for my favorite spot instead. When faced with an unfamiliar situation, I tend to rely on past experiences to guide me. When a friend recommends a new book, I often choose to reread one of my favorites. When planning a vacation, I like to visit places I've been to before. When a new trend emerges, I typically ignore it and continue with my usual preferences. When someone proposes a change in routine, I feel more comfortable maintaining the status quo. When I hear about a new hobby, I usually stick to the activities I already enjoy. When asked to try a new food, I often choose something familiar instead.
